transcript.text: Hi Casey, this is Riley, an automated assistant with Harborline Home Loans, following up on the refinance inquiry you just submitted. Is now a good time for a few quick questions? You can reply STOP at any time.
Hi Riley, yes, now is fine. I'm pretty new to all this, so I hope that's okay!

Totally okay, Casey. I'll keep it simple and explain anything that's unclear. First question: are you mainly hoping to lower your monthly payment or interest rate, or are you looking to take some cash out of your home's value?
Mostly just lowering my monthly payment. I don't need to take any cash out, I'm just hoping to save a bit each month.
Got it, you want to lower your monthly payment and don't need cash out. Roughly what do you think your home is worth right now? A ballpark is fine.
